summary: Phase 1 of 7 complete: the anchor-free lift. drift_lipschitz_two_sided and exists_ladderPath_of_walk_of_pins landed in LadderAgree.lean, sorry-free, with axiom pins in KTypeSummaryAxiomTest.lean. hn0 is derived from hpins through drift_extension_of_pins rather than assumed, so no consumer of the lift constructs an anchor again. Full unscoped lake build green. Two gate collisions recorded: the longFile baseline went to 3100 not the plan's 3400 (the linter requires the file's own round-up, not a forward-looking ceiling), and the commit gate required regenerating typst/generated/status.typ, a third file the plan's phase list does not name. check-module-invariants.sh is red on 3 stale README inventory blocks, which is Phase 6's declared scope and expected across Phases 1-4.
